timeline.summary: Aarti Pharmalabs released its Q4 FY26 and annual results presentation, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹18,194 Mn for FY26.
Jeevan Mondkar (ICSI M. No. A22565) uploaded the Q4-FY26 earnings conference call recording on May 26, 2026, at [link](https://www.aartipharmalabs.com/q4-fy-26).
Aarti Pharmalabs reported Q4 FY26 earnings with annual revenue at ₹1,798 Cr and guided for 15-18% CAGR over the next 3-4 years.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹610.45 Cr (+45.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹68.92 Cr (includes ₹6.88 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹64.59 Cr).
Aarti Pharmalabs released its Q2 FY27 presentation, announcing ₹149 Cr Atali Block 2 capex and reiterating 15-18% medium-term CAGR guidance.
Audio recording of Q2 earnings conference call uploaded on company website, link https://www.aartipharmalabs.com/q2-fy-27/
